story_ratings.note: Nia’s solo follows Mateo’s reluctance, but repeated dialogue and the unexplained drums left on the shelf make the ending feel unfinished.

assessment.diversity_evidence: All six stories begin with the same hoped-for duet, Mateo’s reluctance, and Nia’s solo choice. Five (s000014, s000028, s000058, s000023, s000017) end with the solo and drums on the shelf; s000036 alone changes the causal outcome when Mateo later agrees to a private duet. Wording varies only slightly, so the set has little plot or language diversity.
